cache_policy: legacy AAA caches are diagnostic only; reuse compact depths only when model/configuration, rank selection, bath audit, time grid and finite data match
bath_rule: 20k construction and independent 40k audit; joint-complex ESPIRA-I ranks 8--60; two consecutive BCF passes; select the lower rank; prefer <=35 and require <=60 exponents
required_rule: at least three consecutive depths; the highest adjacent pair passes full/late/max population gates; the preceding pair either passes or all three errors improve; the final A/B populations are physical and trace preserving
